editorial_thesis: Today’s strongest practical signals connect AI adoption to accountable controls: budget exceptions, misalignment evidence, realtime interaction contracts, and clearly labeled agentic commerce.

topic_groups.title: AI Spend + Outcome Controls
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Fresh primary-source signal with direct Buildn/client trial value; rotated away from yesterday’s GitHub governance, persistent workspaces, and edge-runtime security lanes.
